span.p:
Global State Layer
[KV Store] [Durable Objects] [R2 Storage]
Consistent global view via quorum replication

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
User in India ──▶ BGP routes to nearest data center (Mumbai)
Mumbai fails ──▶ BGP converges to next nearest (Singapore)
No DNS change, no failover script, no downtime

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Same Software Stack
[Reverse Proxy] [CDN Cache] [WAF] [DNS]
[Load Balancer] [DDoS Mitigation] [Workers]
330+ Data Centers, All Active, Same IP Anycast
